column5: ROUTE + DETAIL PAGE NOW BUILT (2026-08-05). /play/hilo exists in src/App.tsx and mounts HiLoGame with variant="fullscreen" inside GameShell - the SAME widget the casino grid opens, so the page cannot settle a card differently from the modal - with HiLoPageSections rendering the whole 1440x3294 column beneath it: stats/fairness strip, tabs row, game-info card, Community wins, More-games carousel, Bets panel, About + assurances + Licences + FAQ, footer. Copy in hiloPageContent.ts, cited node by node. The 768 (9058-4372) and 375 (9351-4708) tiers are served by the same page's breakpoints, the sibling /play/* pattern, not by second implementations. hilo added to ROUTED_GAME_PATHS in Play.tsx, PlayOriginals.tsx and GameDetailPage.tsx. HiLoGame gained variant + onSeedChange and its three Dialog wrappers (main, disabled-notice, faucet) became GameShell - shell only, zero lines of card or settlement logic touched. The strip's verifier is fed from roundProof (the four fields the SETTLEMENT response returns together), never the legacy secure-session store, whose hash/clientSeed/bet-COUNT belong to no real round and would report a false 'server seed hash does not match' on an honest round. * CATALOG RE-CUT, EVERY FRAME RENDERED AND READ. This section is mis-filed in BOTH directions and the previous verdict had two of them backwards. NOT HI-LO (Scratchers filed under Hi-Lo): 9058-1833 "Desktop" is a 3x3 match-3 symbol grid under a "Match 3 to Win!" header with a six-symbol 1.98x paytable; 9058-7261 is that same paytable row; 9058-2367 "Card out" is a generic Manual/Auto bet panel with no higher/lower control at all; 9058-5154 (768x1607) is genuinely Scratchers AND correctly titled - match-3 board, Manual/Auto, Bet/Target. NOT SKAI AT ALL, must never be built: 9332-27318 and 9332-27319 are phone photos of stake.us (Stake wordmark, Login/Register, "Stake Originals", "stake.us - Private" in the browser bar) - a COMPETITOR's Hi-Lo. Their paytable (Same 7.69% / Lower 92.31%, Net Gain 12.87x / 1.07x) is Stake's and was copied nowhere. HI-LO BUT MIS-TITLED - correcting the earlier verdict: 9058-4372 (768x1627) is titled "Skai > Play > Casino > Scratchers" in its layer name AND in its own rendered breadcrumb, but it is the HI-LO TABLET page (3-of-hearts card, King/Ace ghost cards, Profit Higher (1.17x) / Profit Lower (4.29x), drawn-cards strip, Bet panel); and 9351-4708 is titled "Blackjack (375 x 812px)" but is the Hi-Lo 375 page at 375x1605. CORRECTLY FILED HI-LO: 9061-10499 (desktop start), 9061-9472 (desktop loss), 9332-27320 (mobile board), 9351-3397 (hero illustration) and 9079-3253 (an image node named "Screenshot 2026-07-23..." whose content is a SKAI Hi-Lo board - same King/Ace ghosts, same Profit Higher/Lower fields - so a reference capture, not a competitor photo). NEITHER: 9058-6701 "Layout" is the SHARED stats/fairness strip every game detail page draws. Real Hi-Lo surface = 7 frames (2 desktop, 1 tablet, 2 mobile, 1 hero, 1 capture), not 12. * FRAME NUMBER BUGS, REPORTED NOT BUILT: for identical stated odds (Higher-or-Same 30.77%, Lower-or-Same 76.92%) the Start frame prints Higher 1.17x / Lower 4.29x while the Loss frame prints 3.22x / 1.29x. Only Loss is arithmetically consistent (0.99/0.3077 = 3.22); Start is INVERTED and would be house-negative if built as drawn. The tablet frame 9058-4372 repeats Start's inverted pair, and the mobile board 9332-27320 is worse again - ONE probability (53.58%) against BOTH arrows while still showing 1.17x / 4.29x. None of those numbers were copied: the page renders no odds or profit figures, and the widget computes its own from the live config. * FRAME NUMBERS NOT REPRODUCED (no-mock rule): the Community-wins sample rows (@CryptoQueen88, $8,481.10, 2.67x, every row labelled "Blackjack"), the "N playing" counts and "Total: $89.01" - the desktop frame's Community-wins figure, which no rail produces. The page renders the live useRecentBets / liveGamingService feeds and the design's honest empty states instead, and ships the 375 frame's "All time" range pill where desktop draws the fabricated total. Also dropped: "Try Crash in Fun Mode" (wrong game AND a mode no Skai title has) and the two Figma authoring defects ("verified using verified", "exlusive"). * STILL OPEN, unchanged by this pass and owned by whoever holds the widget internals: HiLoGame implements none of the frame's Skip Card control, the King/Ace ghost cards flanking the live card, the split Profit(High)/Profit(Low) fields or the drawn-cards strip, and it adds a 7777 JACKPOT toggle (JACKPOT_NUMBER) that appears in no frame. * ECONOMICS unchanged and consistent: admin key hilo_house_edge is a FRACTION (default 0.01), the client reads it as one, and the live POINTS rail points-game:5313 is also 99/wc - they AGREE at 1%, no player-visible discrepancy. The dormant money rail game-settlement:3957 uses 95/wc, so enabling REAL_MONEY_PLAY_ENABLED would cut Hi-Lo payouts 4.21%. Hi-Lo running 1% while Dice/Mines/Chicken/Crash run higher is a product decision, not a bug. Page verified by typecheck + build; frames not yet visually diffed.
